_derivation: bpp = kbps/(fps*pixels). Floor rung 2 (9264 kbps) -> 0.0497 bpp; top rung 5 (19646 kbps) -> 0.105 bpp. Encode size is the largest on the ladder clearing the 0.04 bpp floor at rung 2. Rung bitrates are §9.5 derived from the Pass 122 table (table_version 0x80), not estimated.
_apply: venc fields go to waybeam_venc (sensor.mode and video0.size are restart_required, so this is a pre-flight choice); link fields are merged into /etc/waybeam-link/craft.json. Restart venc (S95waybeam) then the link (S96waybeam-link), then re-scout + quickconnect — a craft restart leaves CSA silently dead otherwise (B9).
_slices: sliceCount 9 (§6.3b). The concealed area on a loss is max(1/N, the byte fraction actually lost), so once a slice is about one 1424 B FEC chunk the area is chunk-limited and finer slices only cost ~26 B each (measured 2026-08-20); coarser ones leave area on the table. Pick the smallest deliverable N at or above that knee, evaluated at this mode's FLOOR rung 2 (9264 kbps at long GI, 100 fps) where the overhead is the largest share of the frame: a frame is 8.13 chunks, so N*=8.13 and 1080p can deliver 1/2/3/4/5/6/9/17 (the SDK rounds slice height up to whole CTU-64 rows).
